thread:
maria: FYI — Barometer (enterprise) asked if we can run a short POC with their custom Llama-variant (llama-bar-30b). They want latency under 350ms p95 and KV cache enabled. Can ops + sec weigh in?

devon: Sounds doable. Two immediate checks: 1) model binary format (hf vs ggml) and 2) whether their model supports our KV cache hook. Do we have a compatibility matrix?

jordan: I pulled their sample model — it’s HF-flavored but uses a custom attention op. We need a runtime compatibility pass. If the op is missing we can still serve with a fallback quantized variant but perf will drop.

leo: For the latency target we should size a Dedicated pool (A10G x2) + continuous batching config. Estimate: 30b dense -> ~300ms p95 with batching disabled, but with their prompt sizes it might spike. Need exact seq len.

anika: Security side: they'll need KMS integration and an SSA+NDA signed. Also their legal wants answers on data residency and audit logs. We have the Private + KMS flow but need time estimates to get HSM if required.

maria: They also pressed on pricing — they expect an enterprise trial price, and will run ~200k tokens/day for 2 weeks. What should we propose for trial credits / burst?

devon: For trials we typically give a $5k credit and a short Dedicated promo (30% off first month). For the POC, offer a Dedicated dev pool with soft SLA and monitoring. If they require Private, that's a different quote.

jordan: Quick technical ask — can we load a quantized q4_kv variant to avoid custom op issues? If we can map weights to our int4 path we avoid kernel gaps. Otherwise need to implement an op shim.

leo: We have a q4_kv runtime path compatible with HF format. Two caveats: reduced quality (some hallucination risk) and smaller token throughput per GPU. Ops needs a approve to spin up a test worker.

anika: Also flag: customer requires AICPA SOC2 section on key rotation and a one-time security questionnaire (30 questions). I can handle the questionnaire but need details on: where logs are stored, retention period, and if we can enable request-level masking for PII.

maria: I'll send the questionnaire now. Can someone draft answers for logs + kv cache behavior?

jordan: Draft: logs stored in Redact+S3 with 90d default retention; can extend to 365d on request. KV cache stores prefix keys in-memory only, not persisted to disk unless Private with persistence enabled. We can also enable request-level masking via redaction pipeline. (needs sec sign-off)

anika: Good start. Add: KMS handles envelope encryption, rotation every 90 days by default; HSM available for Private deployments. Also add our incident contact and SOC2 report link: https://redwood.dev/security/soc2.pdf

leo: Ops note — to validate latency I need a small canary: load their model on a staging worker and run the customer's prompt set (they said avg seq 256, max 1024). Command I’ll run:
```
redwoodctl spawn --model ./barometer-30b --quant q4_kv --gpu a10g --name baro-test
redwoodctl perf --target-p95 350 --prompts prompts.json
```
Will report perf + mem.

maria: Timeline ask from customer: start POC next Monday, 2-week run, decision end of month. Is that tight?

devon: Tight but OK if we pre-stage the model and sec questionnaire is cleared. Jordan & Leo — can you confirm staging by Friday EOD so we can commit?

jordan: I'll try to produce a q4_kv build today and run a quick pass. If custom attention breaks, I’ll fallback to a transformer-compatible rewrite or request a patch from them.

leo: I can reserve a dev Dedicated slot for next week but need billing approval for temporary capacity. @maria can you confirm entitlement?

maria: Confirmed — I’ll approve the temporary dev pool and allocate trial credits. I’ll also tell the customer we need their signed NDA before we proceed.

anika: I’ll take the questionnaire — ping me the filled draft once you have model persistence and logging language. I’ll add the compliance bits.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: baro-test on staging at 2026-04-03T09:00Z (ticket #POC-4821).

maria: Next steps: 1) Jordan produce q4_kv trial build (today) 2) Leo reserve dev pool + run perf canary (Fri) 3) Anika finalize security answers (Fri) 4) I send NDA and trial quote to customer (today). I’ll update customer after we have perf numbers.

devon: Also add a note for pricing: if they go production with Dedicated > 1M tokens/day, propose reserved capacity with a 6-12 month commit — include quantization discount.

jordan: Updated: q4_kv build done, initial pass looks OK on 30b (some quality degradation in long-form). Uploading artifact to staging.

leo: Ran perf: p95 ~340ms on A10Gx2 with batching minimal, memory headroom 18GB. KV cache populate time negligible. Attaching logs to ticket.

anika: Security answers draft ready, added masking and KMS details. Please review: https://redwood.internal/poc/POC-4821/sec-draft (internal).

maria: Great — I’ll loop in the customer and propose start Monday. If they sign NDA today we can start. Thanks team! :rocket:
